_comment_1: Copy this to bridge_config.json and fill in your values. bridge_config.json is git-ignored.
_comment_2: rclone_remote: name you gave the remote when you ran `rclone config` (default: gdrive)
_comment_3: drive_folder: name of the folder in Google Drive where Health Sync writes CSVs
_comment_4: cache_dir: local disk path where rclone drops synced CSVs
_comment_5: dashboard_repo: local clone of davelane26/weight-dashboard-v2 (PUBLIC, served via GitHub Pages) with a push-capable remote (PAT in remote URL). health.json is committed here so it's fetched same-origin by the dashboard, no CORS, no Cloudflare Worker needed.
_comment_6: health_json_filename: output filename inside the dashboard repo
